Sustainable Packaging in 2026: Materials, Certifications and Claims

Published August 28, 2026 · Buyer guide · By BestPackFactory

Quick answer

Sustainable packaging decisions should follow the disposal reality of your market: choose materials that fit available collection channels, verify certifications (FSC, compostability standards, recycled content), and keep claims specific and verifiable. Regulatory expectations around packaging (including extended producer responsibility rules in the EU) are tightening, so confirm obligations with advisors.

Claims must match disposal reality

A pack labeled recyclable only helps if the local system actually collects and recycles it. Research the channels in your markets and choose materials that fit them.

Certifications need verification

FSC, compostability and recycled-content claims rest on certificates and declarations. Verify validity, scope and coverage with the supplier before printing claims.

Regulation is tightening

Extended producer responsibility, packaging rules and reporting obligations are expanding, especially in the EU. Confirm your obligations with compliance advisors and plan data collection early.

Design for fewer, better materials

Mono-material structures simplify recycling; lightweighting reduces material and freight. Balance these against barrier and protection needs with testing.

Buyer checklist

  1. Research local disposal channels
  2. Verify certificates and scope
  3. Confirm regulatory obligations
  4. Prefer mono-material where possible
  5. Keep claims specific and documented

Frequently asked questions

Is "recyclable" a safe claim?

Only if the material fits a real collection channel in your market; verify before printing.

What does FSC certification cover?

It certifies the fiber chain for responsible forestry; verify the supplier scope and certificate.

Are compostable packs automatically better?

Only if industrial composting channels exist in your market; otherwise they may perform no better than conventional film.

What the Spec Means for Buyers

Sustainable packaging claims need material-level support. Available options: kraft board and liner (120/140/170 gsm), E/B/BC flute corrugated with recyclable construction, kraft with PLA liner flexible pouches, compostable films (NK/NKME/PBS or Kraft/PLA with TUV AUSTRIA Home Compostable and EN 13432 / ASTM D6400 compliance), and molded pulp or paperboard inserts. Certifications and test reports are confirmed for the selected structure — never claimed generically. MOQ is 500 PCS per size and artwork.
